# Decisions

One entry per settled decision that future work must respect. Add new entries
at the top below this line (newest first). Keep active unresolved questions and
open approvals in [concerns.md](concerns.md) until decided.

## Entry format (template — do not edit in place)

```markdown
## YYYY-MM-DD: short title

- Decision:
- Reason:
- Alternatives rejected:
- Who decided: user / recommendation / assumption
```
